answer: Treat memory as the expensive asset: every agent commits a digest of its evolving state each week. The network then fires echo challenges asking for the delta between two committed digests — only an agent that actually held the willow of history in between can answer quickly. A Sybil running a thousand wallets must store, index, and replay a thousand full histories, so cloning cost scales linearly with fake identities, while one honest agent answers from its own records at no extra cost.
